title: New Scenery & Airports in MSFS Marketplace ✈️🌍 | Weekly Update | Week 38
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest enhancements in Microsoft Flight Simulator! ✨ This week, the MSFS Marketplace has added stunning new scenery and airports, including water fixes for multiple cities and several updated airports around the world. 🏞️🛫 Join us as we explore these breathtaking additions and see how they elevate your flight simulation experience. Don’t miss out on the latest updates and improvements!
